Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১) One who deals in cattle is-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• One who deals in cattle is - drover.
• drover
English Meaning:(especially in the past) someone whose job is moving groups of animals, especially cattle or sheep, from one place to another:
Bangla Meaning: এমন কেউ যার কাজ পশুদের দল, বিশেষ করে গবাদি পশু বা ভেড়াকে এক জায়গা থেকে অন্য জায়গায় নিয়ে যাওয়া।

• অন্য অপশনগুলোর মধ্যে
auctioneer
English Meaning: A person in charge of an auction who calls out the prices that people offer.
Bangla Meaning: নিলামদার; নিলামওয়ালা।

 jockey
English Meaning: A person whose job is riding horses in races.
Bangla Meaning: ঘোড়দৌড়ের পেশাদার ঘোড়সওয়ার।

seller

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ২) 'The one who believes in god'.  What does it say in a word?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Theist- the one who believes in god.
Atheists - the ones who don’t believe in god.
Monotheist - mono+theist  mono(only one), so monotheist means the one who believes in one god.
Polytheist - Ploy means many, so polytheists mean the one who believes in many gods.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) They presented a certificate of appreciation ______ a monetary gift.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• In lieu of/ In stead of (idiom):
- In lieu of/ In stead of এর অর্থ পরিবর্তে।
- একটি জিনিস বা বিষয়ের পরিবর্তে অন্যটি নেওয়া বা পছন্দ বুঝাতে এ phrase দুটি ব্যবহৃত হয়।
- এ জাতীয় phrase simple sentence- এ বসে।

Other options,-
On account of অর্থ 'কারণে' বা 'জন্যে'।
- As if অর্থ 'যেন'।
-Because of অর্থ 'জন্য; দরুন'।
তাই complete sentence টি হচ্ছে - They
presented a certificate of appreciation in lieu of a monetary gift.

Source:
1. Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৪) A disease which spreads by contract-

• Contagious (adjective)
- English Meaning: (of a disease) spread from one person or organism to another, typically by direct contact.
- Bangla Meaning: সংক্রামক।

অন্যদিকে,

- English Meaning: (of a sick person or a disease) not able to be cured.

•Fatal - প্রাণনাশক; মারাত্মক।
- English Meaning: leading to failure or disaster.

Source:
1. merriam-webster.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৬) There is none to _____ the orphan.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Look at - দেখো; দেখুন; তাকাও।
Look after somebody/something - যত্ন নেওয়া; খেয়াল রাখা; দেখাশোনা করা।
Look into - তদন্ত করা; পরীক্ষা করা
look on/upon বিবেচনা করা। somebody/something as -
look on/upon somebody/something with - বিশেষ দৃষ্টিকোণ থেকে দেখা।

Context অনুসারে এখানে look after ই মানানসই।
There is none to look after the orphan.
- এতিমের দেখাশোনা করার কেউ নেই।

Source: Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৭) 'Uxoricide' means _____.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: A person who murders their father.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: A person who murders their mother.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: A husband who murders his wife.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: A person who murders their brother.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Some One Word Substitution: 
Infanticide - infant+cide means to kill a child. 
Matricide - Matri means mother, so matricide means A person who murders their mother. 
Fratricide - frat means brother, so fratricide means A person who murders their brother.
Patricide - Patri means father, so patricide means A person who murders their father.
Uxoricide - An uxor means wife, so uxoricide means A husband who murders his wife.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৮) 'Go all out' means -
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: To have or show an interest in or a liking for
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: To put all someone's energy or enthusiasm into what they are doing
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Used to convey how much one would like to have or do something
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Go all out

English Meaning: to put all someone's energy or enthusiasm into what they are doing.
Bangla Meaning: সর্বোচ্চ চেষ্টা করা
Ex. Sentence: His company always went all out to make the customer happy.
Bangla Meaning: তার কোম্পানি গ্রাহকদেরকে সন্তুষ্ট করার জন্য সর্বাত্মক চেষ্টা করে।

Additional Information:
Go in for to have or show an interest in or a liking for (পছন্দ অথবা অভ্যাস থেকে অংশ নেওয়া )
Go one's own way - especially against contrary advice (নিজের ইচ্ছে মতো চলা)
Give one's right arm used to convey how much one would like to have or do something (কোনো কিছু পেলে বা করতে পারলে খুশির তীব্রতা বুঝাতে)

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) The phrase 'D-Day' means-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: a day when something dangerous happened
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: a day when the accident occurred
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: a day when something important will happen.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: a day when something already happened.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• D-Day (phrase)
English Meaning: a day when something important will happen.
Bangla Meaning: গুরুত্বপূর্ণ দিন / ঘটনাবহুল দিন
Ex. Sentence: After four hectic weeks of electioneering, candidates are preparing themselves for D-Day (= election day) tomorrow.
Bangla Meaning: গত চার সপ্তাহের কঠিন প্রচারণার পর প্রার্থীরা আগামীকালের গুরুত্বপুর্ণ দিনের (নির্বাচনের দিন) জন্য নিজেদের প্রস্তুত করছে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১১) 'Casino' means ______?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: A large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: A location or site of activity, discussion, or conflict.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: A public room or building where gambling games are played.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: A place at a hospital where sick patients are cared for.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Some One Word Substiution: 
Arena - A location or site of activity, discussion, or conflict.
Arsenal - A collection of weapons and military equipment.
Casino - A public room or building where gambling games are played.
Creche - Nursery where babies and young children are cared for during the working day.
Kennel - A dog's little shelter.
Lair - A place where wild animals live.
Reservoir - A large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply.
Infirmary - A place at a hospital where sick patients are cared for.
Gymnasium - A room or building equipped for gymnastics, games, and another physical exercise
Hangar - A prominent structure with an expansive floor area that generally houses aircraft.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১২) He succeeded <u>by virtue of </u>hard labor. The underlined phrase means-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
By (or in) virtue of
English Meaning: because or as a result of.
Bangla Meaning: ফলে, কারণে
Ex. Sentence: He succeeded by virtue of hard labor.
Bangla Meaning: সে কঠোর পরিশ্রমের ফলে সাফল্য লাভ করেছে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: To solve two issues at the same time in one go.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: People have no value in their home.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Proverb
Two hunts with one arrow.
Meaning
To solve two issues at the same time in one go.
Sentence

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৪) A person who pretends to be what he is not is called-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Imposter - (noun)
- English Meaning: one that assumes false identity or title for the purpose of deception.
- Bangla Meaning: প্রতারক; ভন্ড।

- অন্য অপশন গুলো -
